summary: Documents extensions to LDP and RSVP that the Optical Internetworking Forum defined for optical user network interface signaling. They consist of new data objects and error codes, and this informational memo records them and their assigned values.

eli5.summary: The Optical Internetworking Forum added new message parts for optical connections. This note writes down those parts so their numbers are on record.

questions: optical uni signaling ldp rsvp extensions
